due_when.clears_when: Either send_test_ping.py no longer writes a real emitted-status journal row (or the reticket-suppression guard explicitly excludes test-ping tickets), the three now-false "nothing journaled" doc/comment claims are corrected, and a regression test exists asserting this — or the operator has reviewed the finding and explicitly decided not to change it.

origin.rerun: Read src/prop/breakout_executor.py::emit_prop_ticket in full and confirm the prop_journal.record_ticket call (status="emitted") still runs unconditionally on leg.decision=="place" ahead of the _emitter branch; grep for tests/test_prop_send_test_ping*.py to see if coverage now exists.

what: CA-A07 code audit: scripts/prop/send_test_ping.py (the send-prop-test-ping Tier-1 system-action) is documented in 3 places (its own docstring, scripts/ops/send_prop_test_ping_action.sh, docs/claude/system-actions.md) as 'nothing journaled', but breakout_executor.emit_prop_ticket unconditionally writes a real 'emitted' ticket to prop_journal whenever leg.decision=='place', regardless of the _emitter injection used by --no-push/--no-telegram. With the action's own defaults (breakout_1, SOLUSDT, long, 1h) that row exactly matches the account's real routed strategy/symbol/direction and can silently suppress a genuine subsequent trend_donchian_sol/eth signal via _reticket_suppress_reason for up to ~1h (its TTL). Finding: AUD-20260927-CA-A07-testping-journals-and-can-suppress-real-trade in docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-A07.findings.jsonl. Tier-2 fix needed (exclude test-ping tickets from the reticket-suppression status check, or route the test ping through a path that never journals status='emitted'), plus a regression test (none exists today) asserting the journal/suppression state is unaffected by a test-ping invocation.
